response.evidence: In the Recipe section: "Build your container by running the following command in your project's root directory... docker build -t <your-astro-image-name> . This will output an image, which you can run locally or deploy to a platform of your choice." followed by "To run your image as a local container, use the following command." with the command "docker run -p <local-port>:<container-port> <your-astro-image-name>".
response.rationale: The page instructs you to first build an image with docker build -t <your-astro-image-name> ., and then to run that same image (<your-astro-image-name>) as a local container with docker run. So the image run locally is the one produced by the preceding build command, not the Node base image or the Alpine alternative.
